entries.en: The vids are all talking about "Commander Shepard fighting for all of us back home."
And your grace and skill have inspired a whole legion of admirers, too!
And they also say that you don't take crap from anybody! You're showing them what humans can do.
You remember me? Wow.
Guys must try to talk to a lady like you all the time, but you remember me. That really means something.
Even while you're out there kicking ass, you don't forget the rest of us. That says a lot about you, Shepard.
Hey, could I get your picture?
Are you kidding? Nobody will believe I talked with the beautiful Commander Shepard unless I get a picture!
You're a hero, Shepard. Decades from now, humanity is going to remember you. And I'll have your picture.
Just hold up your gun. Perfect!
Thanks again, Commander! I'm going to hang this in my living room! My wife will love it!
Why the hell would I care about this, Conrad? I've been nice, but you're wasting my time.
I've got a lot going on right now, but I can spare a moment.
Conrad, I don't think that's a good idea.
Conrad, I haven't been shot in the head nearly enough times to make that seem like a good idea.
Why would you want to be a Spectre, Conrad?
Okay, let's see. I'm a bad guy. Stop me from killing you.
What about your wife, Conrad? She trusts you, too. Aren't you letting her down?
This is what the Blitz felt like, Conrad! You like it?
I believe you, Conrad. But there's another fight that needs you.
Conrad, you have no idea what it takes to get the job done.
Because you're not a soldier, Conrad. You can't handle this. Go home.
This is how a gun in your face feels! It happens to me every day! You can't handle this.
If you're really willing to do whatever it takes, you'll go home, Conrad.
You know what keeps me going out here? Knowing that people back home are keeping humanity strong.
Conrad, I don't need you. Your wife does. So get out of here.
Conrad, you're not Spectre material, even if I had that kind of pull.
Being a Spectre is a big responsibility. I just want to make humanity proud.
Right. Conrad. We talked awhile back.
I don't have a problem with it, but... why?
Sure. No problem.
I don't have time for this crap! Go back to whatever hole you crawled out of!
Again? No.
Conrad, I'm pretty busy.
I'm afraid not.
You've got to be kidding.
Here's a test.
Let's talk about trust.
There are no good fights
There are other fights.
That's a load of crap.
It's not that easy.
It's not going to happen.
This isn't your fight.
You need to learn.
I need people at home.
Just be yourself.
Oh, it's you.
No! Get out of here!
I wish I'd never met you!
You were too busy to talk last time, but that's not a problem. I know you're busy, being the first human Spectre and all!
This will be fast. I just wanted you to know what a big fan I am, and I was wondering if I could get a picture.
So that's how it is? The rest of us should just let you reap the fame and glory?
You're not the only one who can stand up for humanity! I'll show you!
There's a lot going on right now. Is there something I can do for you?
I apologize for being short with you before. What do you need?
Get lost.
It's a bad idea.
Best place on this ward to buy upgrades.
Prices are pretty good here.
Have you been to the Emporium up on the Presidium?
Try the markets downstairs if you can't find what you're looking for.
I don't think you bought this here. I don't sell this model.
Look, I know it was you. I remember your face.
Really? That's impressive. Usually you humans can't tell one turian from another.
This was the place. Now are you going to give me a refund or not?
Do you have your proof of purchase?
What! No, I-- I don't think you ever gave me one.
I'm sorry, then. I can't help you.
This isn't a proof of purchase.
It's a bank statement. It shows that I bought something from you and when I bought it.
Well, thank you for buying from me, but this still doesn't prove you purchased that item from my store.
But I didn't buy anything else here!
How do I know that? If you don't have the proof of purchase I can't help you.
Oh, sure, I can return that for you.
Thanks. It hasn't worked well since I bought it.
Hey, are you refunding his stuff?
Here you go. Your account will be credited.
You did! You took his return. Look, I'm telling you I bought this here. Why won't you return it?
I can't take it back unless--
I know, I know.. unless I have a proof of purchase.
Hello, Earth-clan. No doubt you've just come back from the colonies. Will you be needing supplies?
Most excellent. I am sure you will find something pleasing.
As you say, Earth-clan. Good day to you.
Oh, my mistake, Earth-clan. I assumed... it doesn't matter.
Feros, Noveria? Well, if you haven't heard of them yet, I'm sure you will soon.
But it doesn't matter where you hail from, my goods are available to all.
Welcome back, Earth-clan. Will you be needing supplies for your return to the colonies?
What colonies are you talking about?
Colonies
It's an old Prothean world. Their buildings still litter the surface.
The humans aren't the first to colonize it, but they are the most recent.
Hmm. I just realized I haven't heard from my contact on that planet for some time.
Ah, well. I'm sure he's fine.
The corporate capital of the Attican Traverse. Very cold, very snowy.
I don't get too many clients from there. They all have their own private suppliers.
I'd like to know more about Feros.
Let me see your goods.
Hello there. Welcome to Morlan's famous shop. You want many good supplies, yes?
But I was told the doctor would be bringing them.
There's been a change of plans.
A change? But... the doctor... I don't.... This is not right, human.
What the hell's going on here? Who are you?
We can end this if you just bring me those supplies. Otherwise, I'll start telling people about the doctor's little secret.
Hey, hold on! I'm just the middleman here.
This is way more than I bargained for.
Thank you, human. It is good to see him humbled so.
I won't go down without a fight!
You were expecting a delivery of medical supplies.
Leave the doctor alone.
Leave the doctor alone. Or you'll have to deal with me.
You're shutting down a medical clinic. What if someone needs treatment? What if you need treatment?
Her secret stays buried. Or I bury you.
That secret dies with you!
I'm here about Dr. Michel.
A friend of Dr. Michel.
This is over.
You should reconsider.
Talk and you're dead!
Oh, you will be pleased, I think. Very good things I have, you will see.
Yes, all right then. Good tidings to you, human.
I have never met him, human. I only worked with the one who spoke with the doctor.
What do you know about Banes?
Who's Banes?
Change of plans.
Things have changed, Morlan.
Yes, human? You need something, yes?
Shut up, Morlan. I told Banes you'd screw this up!
Only if you're willing to die happy.
Then we do this the hard way!
Maybe we can find a way to make both sides happy here.
You're not getting anything from the doctor.
Your worst nightmare.
Let's work this out.
Well, that will certainly change things around here.
For the better. He was a brute. A bully.
[View Armors]
Hold it right there.
Just throw me the data and you can walk away.
I didn't come out to play games with you, human.
You know who I am, and I know you're stalling.
I don't think so, human.
I'll ask you one more time. Give me the data and you and Jahleed will live to see another day.
Fine, have it your way.
Wait! I give up. I give up! Please... don't kill me.
No! Look, Jahleed can have the data. I don't want it. Not if it means I'm going to die.
What is this data? Why is it so important?
I thought you knew. He said you were going to deliver it.
The keepers are almost impossible to scan, and you can't capture them or get samples. They just self-destruct.
After centuries here, we still don't know anything about them.
